description: As an IT Security Analyst at a healthcare organization, you must process a security incident. Employee David Kim has reported his company laptop stolen. Perform the following incident response steps in Snipe-IT: (1) Locate the laptop currently checked out to David Kim and check it back in. (2) Change that laptop's status to 'Lost/Stolen'. (3) Update that laptop's notes to include 'SECURITY INCIDENT #SI-2025-0042: Reported stolen on 2025-03-06. Police report filed. Remote wipe initiated.' (4) Find the available MacBook Pro 16 in the New Hire Pool (ASSET-L009) and check it out to David Kim with the checkout note 'Emergency replacement for stolen device - SI-2025-0042'. (5) Create a new asset to track the insurance claim with these details: asset tag 'ASSET-L012', name 'Lenovo ThinkPad T14s - Insurance Claim', model 'Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 4', status 'Pending', serial 'INSURANCE-CLAIM-SI-2025-0042', purchase date '2025-03-06', purchase cost $1,549.99, warranty 0 months, and note 'Insurance replacement pending - tracking stolen device SI-2025-0042'.
